## Projects

### Traffic Vision (2026)
7-class detector (vehicles, license plates) built by fine-tuning YOLO11, wired into a web demo to test it live. mAP50 of 0.83.
Tags: Python, PyTorch, ONNX
Demo: https://yolo.nathanchampagne.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/Nchpg/yolo-detection

### iSeg-2017 (2026)
Segmentation of 3 brain tissues (CSF, grey matter, white matter) on infant T1/T2 MRI, a very low-contrast case. A 2.5D U-Net trained and evaluated on the Dice score, with an explicit performance / model size trade-off for embedded, offline deployment.
Tags: Python, PyTorch, U-Net
Demo: https://iseg2017.nathanchampagne.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/Nchpg/iSeg-2017

### HRévolution (2026)
2nd place at the HrFlow.ai GenAI & HR Hackathon. Platform for continuous analysis of job applications, leveraging GenAI for explainable scoring and tagging.
Tags: React, Python, GenAI
GitHub: https://github.com/Nchpg/HRFlow/tree/master/HEpiR-HREvolution

### DINOv2 Ship Classifier (2026)
Two-stage transfer learning on a pretrained DINOv2 ViT-B/14 backbone to sort satellite imagery into 10 ship types. Linear probing reaches 96.5% accuracy, fine-tuning the last backbone blocks 98.4%.
Tags: Python, PyTorch, DINOv2

### RLkart (2026)
Kart racing simulation powered by Reinforcement Learning. Custom web-based track editor and AI agent trained with PPO and PyBullet physics.
Tags: Python, RL, PPO
Demo: https://rlkart.nathanchampagne.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/Nchpg/RLkart

### MNIST CNN from Scratch (2026)
Implementation of a Convolutional Neural Network from scratch in C++ to classify the MNIST handwritten digit dataset.
Tags: C++, Deep Learning
Demo: https://mnist.nathanchampagne.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/Nchpg/mnist-cnn-cpp

### Portfolio (2026)
Portfolio built with Next.js and TypeScript, with WebGL-powered animations and bilingual support.
Tags: Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js
GitHub: https://github.com/Nchpg/portfolio

### NixOS Config & Infra (2024-2026)
Declarative and modular NixOS flake for my personal machine and my self-hosted server. This server runs this portfolio and all the projects showcased here. DNS management, Cloudflare, SSH, security hardening and full server deployment from scratch.
Tags: NixOS, Linux, Docker, Nginx, Cloudflare
GitHub: https://github.com/Nchpg/.dotfiles

### Advent of Code (2023-2025)
My Advent of Code solutions - an annual programming challenge with daily puzzles throughout December.
Tags: Python
GitHub: https://github.com/Nchpg/Advent-of-Code

### OCR Sudoku Solver (2023)
Uses Optical Character Recognition to load a Sudoku image, extract the digits, and applies AI algorithms to solve the puzzle.
Tags: C, GTK, OCR
Report: https://nathanchampagne.com/projects/ocr-sudoku/report.pdf

### MS402 (2023)
Multiplayer video game developed in Unity. Full gameplay loop, networking and level design.
Tags: C#, Unity
Website: https://a2nt.gitlab.io/ms-402-website/
Report: https://nathanchampagne.com/projects/ms402/report.pdf
